source_archive_inspection.scope: Full stream scanned for privacy flag references; no complete companion retained or assembled.

integration.omission_reason: Unused prebuilt distributions embed an older ONNX Web runtime; Reader loads the unchanged upstream source entry and exact external ONNX 1.31.1 packages.
integration.override_scope: Intentional suite overrides; upstream package metadata and source remain unchanged. Compatibility is verified locally, not claimed as an upstream certification.

telemetry.official_native_packages: Linux x64 and Windows x64 core binaries retain 1DS telemetry code; Windows also retains a product telemetry provider and a separate OS diagnostic logging provider.
telemetry.reader_control: src/core/onnx-privacy.cjs sets ORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 and ORT_RUNNING_UNIT_TESTS=1 on the main thread, loaded first by src/desktop/main.cjs and src/core/search.mjs, before worker creation or native initialization.
telemetry.worker_caveat: Default Node worker process.env changes are thread-local copies and do not update the OS environment seen by native getenv/GetEnvironmentVariableW.
telemetry.limits: Source and binary inspection establish the bounded suppression mechanisms; runtime regression evidence is recorded separately. No native Windows execution, removal of diagnostic code, or universal absence of network activity is asserted by this provenance record.

internal_flag_review.name: ORT_RUNNING_UNIT_TESTS
internal_flag_review.status: Upstream internal signal used as a bounded compatibility suppression; not a general public configuration API. Re-review before any ONNX upgrade.
internal_flag_review.production_uses: Only telemetry_environment.h defines the predicate; telemetry_1ds.cc checks it before uploader/device-ID initialization and windows/telemetry.cc checks it before product telemetry provider registration. The remaining matching files are upstream tests. No inference or validation bypass use was found in the scanned repository.
internal_flag_review.scan_limits: All regular members of complete pinned repository source archive scanned; separate Git submodules are not included by GitHub source archives.

separate_os_diagnostics.scope: The independent ONNXRuntimeTraceLoggingProvider in windows/logging/etw_sink.cc is not controlled by these flags. It supplies local diagnostics when an external OS trace session enables it; this path has no HTTP uploader.
separate_os_diagnostics.application_behavior: Reader does not enable the external trace session or configure a diagnostic uploader. No claim that OS diagnostic code is removed.

limits: npm metadata omits gitHead. The official source release and npm integrity pins are separate evidence; source-to-binary reproducibility has not been proved.
The GitHub source archive alone omits separate submodule contents and CMake-fetched dependencies.
The historical native/runtime source companions do not establish ONNX 1.31.1 source coverage; the complete matching source preparation remains pending.
Root ThirdPartyNotices is retained verbatim and is not a claim that every listed component is enabled in every target.
